Richard requested a quote for cleaning services four times a month and two times a month for the same property.

callTranscripts.summary: Richard was billed for four hours, but he claims the cleaners were only there for about an hour and a half. Richard expressed concern about being charged for time not worked and stated he prefers fairness in billing. Tidyups Cleaning acknowledged the misunderstanding and agreed to adjust the invoice from $240 to $180 for an hour and a half of work. Richard confirmed the cleaners arrived at 02:26 PM and left at 04:31 PM. Tidyups Cleaning assured Richard that his cleaners do not try to extend their time unnecessarily and are honest about their work. Richard mentioned he used to work with cleaners frequently in leasing and is interested in establishing an ongoing cleaning arrangement. Richard requested a quote for cleaning services four times a month and two times a month for the same property.

callTranscripts.summary: Richard was billed for four hours, but he claims the cleaners were only there for about an hour and a half. Richard expressed concern about being charged for time not worked and stated he prefers fairness in billing. Tidyups Cleaning acknowledged the misunderstanding and agreed to adjust the invoice from $240 to $180 for an hour and a half of work. Richard confirmed the cleaners arrived at 02:26 PM and left at 04:31 PM. Tidyups Cleaning assured Richard that his cleaners do not try to extend their time unnecessarily and are honest about their work. Richard mentioned he used to work with cleaners frequently in leasing and is interested in establishing an ongoing cleaning arrangement. Richard requested a quote for cleaning services four times a month and two times a month for the same property.

callHistory.summary: Richard was billed for four hours, but he claims the cleaners were only there for about an hour and a half. Richard expressed concern about being charged for time not worked and stated he prefers fairness in billing. Tidyups Cleaning acknowledged the misunderstanding and agreed to adjust the invoice from $240 to $180 for an hour and a half of work. Richard confirmed the cleaners arrived at 02:26 PM and left at 04:31 PM. Tidyups Cleaning assured Richard that his cleaners do not try to extend their time unnecessarily and are honest about their work. Richard mentioned he used to work with cleaners frequently in leasing and is interested in establishing an ongoing cleaning arrangement. Richard requested a quote for cleaning services four times a month and two times a month for the same property.

callHistory.summary: Richard was billed for four hours, but he claims the cleaners were only there for about an hour and a half. Richard expressed concern about being charged for time not worked and stated he prefers fairness in billing. Tidyups Cleaning acknowledged the misunderstanding and agreed to adjust the invoice from $240 to $180 for an hour and a half of work. Richard confirmed the cleaners arrived at 02:26 PM and left at 04:31 PM. Tidyups Cleaning assured Richard that his cleaners do not try to extend their time unnecessarily and are honest about their work. Richard mentioned he used to work with cleaners frequently in leasing and is interested in establishing an ongoing cleaning arrangement. Richard requested a quote for cleaning services four times a month and two times a month for the same property.

Richard expressed concern about being charged for time not worked and stated he prefers fairness in billing. Tidyups Cleaning acknowledged the misunderstanding and agreed to adjust the invoice from $240 to $180 for an hour and a half of work. Richard confirmed the cleaners arrived at 02:26 PM and left at 04:31 PM. Tidyups Cleaning assured Richard that his cleaners do not try to extend their time unnecessarily and are honest about their work. Richard mentioned he used to work with cleaners frequently in leasing and is interested in establishing an ongoing cleaning arrangement. Richard requested a quote for cleaning services four times a month and two times a month for the same property.
